meta.title: QC Hold on GRN Pending Inspection: refused for a user without the Quality Inspector role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Quality Inspector role and as a Quality Inspector on the same Enterprise tenant.
Open GRN Pending Inspection and execute or inspect the QC Hold action for both roles, recording refusal or absence for the first user and availability for the Quality Inspector.
Verify or record the tenant's RBAC configuration if the action is granted to additional roles.
